title: Fixes merge without reproducing the real reported event, so the problem comes back and is fixed again
whatHappens: A fix merges on unit tests alone, the same agent reports arrive after release, and a new corner redoes the fix.

fixes.text: Briefs for problems that came back require a failing test built from the real reported event (corner-gate-fixes, corner-checkout-emulator)

observations.text: Velocity, 29-30 Oct: 3 fixes merged on 29 Oct (#3059, #3060, #3077) failed within 12 h; repeat reviews are on a third fix, idle alerts on a second. About 10 PR-hours of redo.
